title: Highly Recommended Segway Tour in Barcelona
text:
We did a Segway tour of Barcelona and it was one of the highlights of our trip. The tour took us around many of the city's impressive attractions and historic landmarks, giving us a fantastic introduction to Barcelona.

It was our first time riding a Segway, but the training was straightforward and we quickly felt confident and comfortable. The routes followed safe cycle lanes throughout the city, making the experience enjoyable and stress-free. Along the way, there were plenty of opportunities to stop for photos and admire the beautiful sights.

title: Very beautiful experience!
text:
We had an excellent time during this guided Segway tour. My sister and I really enjoyed the experience, which was both pleasant and original.

The organization was also very accommodating and understanding following an error during our booking, which we particularly appreciated.

Our guide, whose name I unfortunately no longer remember, was very professional, friendly, and attentive.

A very beautiful activity that we recommend without hesitation!
